about: Sooke is a district municipality on southern Vancouver Island west of Victoria, on the Strait of Juan de Fuca at the mouth of the Sooke River. Harbour views, West Coast rainforest approaches, and a gateway role toward Port Renfrew and the Juan de Fuca trail define a capital-region edge community—not downtown Victoria. About 15,000 people live in Sooke.
